encoding: 4-bit values packed two per byte, low nibble then high nibble, row-major
source: ivansglukhov/Moscow_roads; road elevation samples from elevation.nakarte.me
normalization: measured quantile range normalized to 102..124 grayscale, smooth interpolation to 3072x4096
limitation: interpolated from road-sampled elevations, not a complete high-resolution DEM.
